verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party data-export feature, no bulk or full-workspace export, and no offboarding or exit path that returns customer data in open formats. The public REST API with an OpenAPI spec is a developer building block a user could script an export against, not an export capability itself. The spec also says web-app routes are not part of the public API, so it is not shown to reach all data. AWS role deletion only revokes Oneleet's access and is unrelated to exporting data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
